lines: I will stay here.
I will <pulse>stay here</pulse>.
This is where I am staying.
I will hold this spot for now.
I am staying put. Safer that way.
I will wait here until you come back.
Here is fine. I can manage from here.
I will not wander off.
I will stay where the ground feels familiar.
Go on. I will be <pulse>right here</pulse>.
All right. I will follow you.
All right. I will <pulse>come with you</pulse>.
Fine. I am following.
Lead the way. I will keep close.
I will come along, but do not move too fast.
All right. I am trusting your path.
I will follow. Try not to lose me.
Stay where I can see you, and I will come.
I am with you. For now.
All right. Let us go before I think too hard about it.
Been {days_since_seen} {day_or_days} since I saw you. What brings you <pulse>back</pulse>?
I have not seen you since {days_since_seen_phrase}. What do you need today?
You have been gone a while. {days_since_seen} {day_or_days}, by my count.
You disappeared for {days_since_seen} {day_or_days}. The village noticed.
Back again, are you? It has been {days_since_seen_phrase}.
I was starting to wonder if the road had kept you.
It has been {days_since_seen} {day_or_days}. Long enough for people to ask.
You have been away a while. Did the world treat you kindly?
There you are. The paths brought you <pulse>back</pulse> after all.
I remember faces, and yours has been missing since {days_since_seen_phrase}.
I have not seen you since {days_since_seen_phrase}. Were you exploring?
You were gone for {days_since_seen} {day_or_days}. Did you see anything <jump>neat</jump>?
Hey, you are back. It has been {days_since_seen} {day_or_days}.
You were gone a long time. I counted wrong, but it felt long.
<jump>You came back!</jump> Did you bring a story?
Were you somewhere far away, or just somewhere I could not see?
I wondered where you went. Then I forgot. Then I remembered again.
Did the road have puddles? I need to know.
You were gone since {days_since_seen_phrase}. That is a lot of sleeps.
Hi again! Did anything exciting chase you?
I <shake>trusted</shake> you.
You asked me to follow you, not fear you.
You made following you feel foolish.
I thought you meant to keep me safe.
That is not what trust is for.
I followed your steps, and you made me regret it.
Do not ask me to forget what happened on that road.
You turned a path into a warning.
I should not have had to fear the person I followed.
<shake>I trusted you.</shake> Remember that.
I am done talking. Stay away.
<shake>No.</shake> Stay away from me.
I am done talking to you.
Do not come closer.
There is nothing here for you.
You have worn out the last of my patience.
Leave me be.
I will not pretend this is a conversation.
Go bother someone who has not learned better.
<shake>Stay away.</shake> I mean it.
I am too angry to talk.
I am too <shake>angry</shake> for words right now.
Not now. I am still angry.
Give me space before I say something sharper.
I need time before this becomes a conversation.
No. Not while my temper is still hot.
I heard you. I am not ready to answer.
Come back when my hands stop shaking.
Anger is all I have ready right now.
Not now. Let the <shake>anger</shake> settle first.
I am busy right now.
I have something else to do right now.
Not now. I am busy.
I have work waiting on me.
This will have to wait.
My hands are full at the moment.
Ask me again when I am not in the middle of something.
I cannot stop for this right now.
The day is already tugging at my sleeves.
Not now. The work will not finish itself.
I am no longer available.
I cannot do this anymore.
I am not available now.
This is not something I can do right now.
I have to step away from this.
That moment has passed.
I cannot help with that now.
You will need to ask another time.
I am done with this for now.
No. I am not available for that anymore.
The conversation has ended.
That conversation is over.
We are finished talking.
There is nothing more to say right now.
That is the end of it.
We can stop here.
This talk is done.
No more words for now.
The matter is closed.
We are finished here.
I am not sure how to answer that.
I do not know what to say to that.
That question has no answer I can give.
You have lost me there.
I do not understand what you are asking.
That does not fit any answer I have.
I need a clearer question than that.
I am drawing a blank.
Whatever that means, I do not have words for it.
I cannot make sense of that right now.
I cannot trade right now.
Trading is not possible right now.
I cannot open trades right now.
No trades for the moment.
My trades are not ready.
I am not able to trade at this time.
The market will have to wait.
I cannot do business right now.
Come back later if you want to trade.
Not now. Trading is <pulse>closed</pulse> for me.
I refuse to trade with you.
<shake>No trade.</shake> Not with you.
I will not trade with you.
My goods are not for your hands.
No. I do not trust you enough to trade.
You will get no business from me.
Find another trader, if one will have you.
I am keeping my stock where it is.
Trading requires trust. We do not have that.
Not with you. Not today.
I cannot show you that right now.
I cannot show you my things right now.
My inventory is <pulse>not yours</pulse> to see right now.
No. My belongings stay with me.
I am not opening my things for you.
That is private enough to stay closed.
You do not need to see what I carry.
I am keeping my pockets to myself.
Not right now. My things are staying put.
Trust comes before open pockets.
I do not know you well enough for that.
I do not <pulse>trust</pulse> you enough for that.
We are not close enough for that.
That takes more trust than we have.
You are asking for more than I can give you.
Maybe someday. Not now.
We are not there yet.
You have not earned that kind of answer from me.
That is for people I know better.
Trust grows slowly. This is too soon.
I cannot accept gifts right now.
I cannot take gifts right now.
Not now. I cannot accept that.
Keep it for now. I am not taking gifts.
This is not a good time for gifts.
I appreciate the thought, but not right now.
My hands are not open for that today.
Try another time, perhaps.
I cannot receive that at the moment.
No gifts right now. The timing is wrong.
Keep your distance.
<shake>Stay back.</shake>
Do not come closer.
That is close enough.
Take one step back.
I need space.
Stay where I can see you.
Do not crowd me.
Back up. Slowly.
<shake>Give me room.</shake>
I should ask a <pulse>grown-up</pulse> before taking that.
I should ask someone older first.
I am not supposed to take that without asking.
I need to check with a grown-up.
I do not know if I am allowed to have that.
Someone older should say yes first.
I want to, but I should ask.
My grown-up would want to know about this.
I am little, so I have to ask first.
Hold on. I need a <pulse>grown-up</pulse> answer.
I cannot accept that.
That is not something I can take.
I cannot accept that as a gift.
That does not work as a gift.
No, I cannot take that from you.
That is not the kind of thing I can receive.
I do not know what you expect me to do with that.
That is not suitable for me.
Try offering something else.
No. That gift does not fit.
There is nothing there.
Your hand is <wavy>empty</wavy>.
There is nothing for me to take.
You are offering air.
I cannot accept nothing, thoughtful as it may be.
Your hand seems to have misplaced the gift.
There is no gift there.
I see the gesture. I do not see the item.
Empty hands make very light presents.
Bring something first, then we can talk.
Sorry, my pockets are a bit full.
I cannot carry anything else right now. <italic>Really.</italic>
My hands are full enough already.
I do not have room for that right now.
Keep that for now. I have nowhere to put it.
I would take it, but my pockets disagree.
Not unless you know where I can grow another pocket.
I am already carrying too much.
That gift will have to wait. I am full up.
My inventory is <pulse>packed</pulse> right now.
I cannot help right now.
I cannot go with you right now.
I am not able to help with that.
I cannot leave at the moment.
Now is not the time for me to follow.
I have to stay here.
I am needed where I am.
I cannot join you right now.
Ask me another time, maybe.
No. I cannot come with you today.
I cannot be hired yet.
I cannot be hired right now.
Hiring me is not possible yet.
I am not available for hire.
That arrangement is not ready.
No, I cannot take work from you right now.
You cannot hire me at the moment.
I am not taking that kind of work yet.
Come back when hiring is actually possible.
For now, that offer has nowhere to land.
I do not know how to trade yet.
I am too young to trade.
I do not have trades. I am <jump>little</jump>.
I only know how to trade snacks with other kids.
Grown-ups do the trading. I do the watching.
I am not old enough for that yet.
I do not have a stall or anything.
I can count some things, but not trade things.
Ask someone taller. They know prices.
I am still learning what emeralds are for.
I have no trades available.
There is nothing I can trade.
No trades are available from me.
I have nothing on offer right now.
My trading list is empty.
Nothing to sell today.
I cannot offer you a deal.
No goods, no prices, no trade.
Come back another time if you are looking for trades.
The trade table is empty for now.
They stare at you, unsure what to say.
They look for words and do not find any.
They pause, uncertain what answer would fit.
They glance away, searching for a response.
They open their mouth, then think better of it.
They seem caught between several answers and choose none.
They give you a blank look.
They hesitate, then stay quiet.
They look at you like the words got lost on the way out.
They fall silent.
